note: Pita and hummus are verbatim; ishikawa-style independently lists 「フムスとピタパン」 as a menu item. The wheat-in-pita step is the app's standard inference and is correctly stated as a limit rather than a shop claim. gf: options is right.

quote: The cafe is fully plant-based, so there is no animal-product cross-contact risk across the menu.
found: ビーガン料理を提供するカフェ「SIU.COFFEE +VEG（シウ・コーヒー・アンド・ベジ）」（金沢市幸町）が4月24日、オープンした。／金沢・幸町に築100年の町家ビーガンカフェ
note: Local press calls it a vegan cafe outright and food-japon independently titles it 町家ヴィーガンカフェ. No animal item appears on any menu listing I found. vegan: full holds up.

quote: The owner states a mission to provide 'the safest possible meals in Ishikawa,' indicating attention to ingredient safety, though no specific allergen or cross-contamination protocol is documented.
found: 「石川県に、できる限り安全な食事を」という想いを込めて営業されている「SIU.COFFEE +VEG」。
note: The phrase is verbatim and the absence of any allergen protocol on the page is accurate. One attribution fix: the article presents it as the shop's 想い in the writer's own voice, not as something the owner said - 'the owner states' overstates it. The owner's only quoted words are in kanazawa.keizai.biz/headline/3893 and are about lifestyle, not safety.

quote: Entirely vegan menu, so all dishes are free of meat, fish, dairy and egg.
found: ビーガン料理を提供するカフェ／看板メニューは、コロッケや野菜などをピタパンに挟んだ「ファラフェルサンド」…ひよこ豆にゴマ、ニンニクなどを加えてペーストにしたディップ料理「フムス」（700円）も提供する。
note: Every item the article enumerates is plant-based and the venue is described as a vegan cafe. Corroborated by food-japon: 「動物性食材を使っていないとは思えない満足度」.

quote: Offers genuinely gluten-free rice-flour (米粉) sweets — a gateau chocolate made with rice rather than wheat flour — for diners avoiding gluten.
found: ケーキは石川県かほく市にある「atelier 絲（アトリエイト）」さん製の米粉ガトーショコラの抹茶味。
note: Verbatim. Worth adding to the record: the cake is bought in from atelier 絲 in Kahoku, not baked at SIU (keizai: 「米粉ケーキは料理店「atelier 絲」（かほく市）から取り寄せる」), so its gluten status depends on a third party's kitchen and it is then served in a kitchen that handles pita.

quote: Uses oat milk for coffee and house-made ginger syrup, supporting dairy-free ordering.
found: Cited page has the syrup - 「ジンジャーソーダは自家製のジンジャーシロップが絶品。」 - but the strings オーツ/オート/oat appear 0 times in it. Oat milk is on kanazawa.keizai.biz: 「自家製ジンジャーシロップを使う「ジンジャーソーダ」「ジンジャーオーツ」（以上、700円）、「オーツミルクブリュー」（600円）」, which carries both halves in one sentence.
method: plain fetch + zero-hit string check on the cited page
note: Repoint to the keizai article, which sources the oat milk and the house-made ginger syrup together.

3 of 4 claims verbatim on co-trip 50258 (vegan kitchen, named pesticide-free farms, Isehikari rice, soy-meat teriyaki/ginger items). One repair: the muffin claim's rice-flour + daily-handmade detail is not on the kanazawabiyori spot listing it cites (that page supports only 「グルテンフリーのスイーツ」); it is on co-trip. Staleness caveat for the owner: co-trip stamps the article 2016-05-09 and the kanazawabiyori listing describes the 2019 5th-anniversary menu, so nothing here is recent.

ALARMING. 'Tabelog's listing states all menu items are gluten-free' is false twice over: the sentence is a single diner's April-2023 review, not listing data, and kanazawa-tsu prices a グルテンフリーバンズ at +330 yen, which means the default bun contains wheat. The same page also contradicts 'the menu is plant-based and animal-product-free' - it says 「メニューの多くが小麦不使用だったり、動物性の食材を使わないメニューも豊富」 (many, not all), prices ヴィーガンチーズ as a +220 yen swap (so default cheese is dairy) and features 「蟹たっぷりハントンライス」. The two homepage claims are verbatim and fine. Recommend: delete the Tabelog claim outright, rewrite the burger claim as an optional GF/vegan substitution, and drop vegan from full to options.

4 of 5 claims verbatim on the weekend-kanazawa article, including 「小麦粉や乳製品、卵不使用」 as a true quote and the owner's child-allergy origin story. One repair: the oatmeal cross-contact caution is real but オートミール appears 0 times on the cited page - it is on kaname-kanazawa.com/mychiffon/. Also fill in website (currently null): https://www.instagram.com/mychiffon_kome/, whose bio 「シフォンはグルテンフリー、焼き菓子類はヴィーガン」 independently confirms the gf/vegan split the record records.

The gluten claim is the strongest on this shard - manpuku says 「スコーン以外は小麦粉も不使用のグルテンフリー」 and the record correctly carries the scone/wheat exception even though weekend-kanazawa's 2023 piece contradicts it. Defect: the allergy claim asserts the shop 'labels baked goods as egg/butter/wheat-free where applicable', which is on none of the three cited articles - drop that clause. Repair: the 2020 weekend-kanazawa piece cited for the vegan framing contains no vegan or dairy wording at all and predates the May-2023 renovation; use manpuku instead. Also question vegan: full for a grocery whose shelves are described as 「オーガニックやヴィーガン認証商品など」 alongside 醤油・味噌・マヨネーズ・缶詰.

Both quoted Japanese strings are genuinely verbatim and the egg/dairy claim is solid. Two repairs, both pointing at the same missing page - the shop's own salon.html: (1) 'no wheat flour anywhere in the shop' and (2) the owners' wheat allergy are stated there, not on the cited pages. Read salon.html before rewording: the shop says 「店内での使用しておりませんが副資材においてコンタミネーション…の可能性はゼロとは言い切れません。ご購入の際にはご自身での慎重なご判断をお願いいたします。」 - it refuses to call contamination zero, so 'cross-contact is essentially eliminated' is stronger than the shop's own claim and should be softened.

5 of 8 claims are verbatim and well-judged, including the 「当店のキッシュは全てグルテンフリー」 quote and the correct reading that the shared-facility caveat is written for egg/dairy. Two defects, both on claims citing the bare homepage, which carries no allergen data at all: 'a pizza page lists shrimp and dairy' (the archived 米粉ピザセット page has no allergen block and no shrimp or dairy in its ingredients) and 'no wheat products are made on-site' (published nowhere - it is exactly the kitchen-level guarantee the shop has never made). One repair: the 白山市地産地消推奨店 certification is real but is on the city register, not the urara page cited. Also drop 'shrimp' from the allergen list - the disclosure names たまご・乳製品 only.

6 of 7 claims supported, including two verbatim 「」 quotes and a correct 'nothing published about the griddle' absence claim that I confirmed across all six sources. One repair: the Instagram-DM detail is on manpuku, not on the weekend-kanazawa page cited. Two wording fixes worth making: the ameblo blogger is wheat-allergic, not celiac (「小麦アレルギーで醤油も。他麦はOK！」) - the record upgrades her, which inflates the evidence; and the keizai 「全てグルテンフリーに対応した商品にする」 sentence is about a planned baked-goods line, not the standing menu. Note the exblog source needs an iPhone UA (desktop 403s).

5 of 6 claims verbatim; the pita/hummus wheat limit and the fully-vegan framing both hold across two independent outlets. One repair: the oat-milk claim cites ishikawa-style, where オーツ appears 0 times - kanazawa.keizai.biz carries oat milk and the house-made ginger syrup in one sentence. Two softenings: 'the owner states' the safety mission is the writer's framing (「という想いを込めて営業されている」), not an owner quote; and the 米粉 gateau chocolate is bought in from atelier 絲 in Kahoku rather than baked at SIU, so its gluten status rests on a third party's kitchen.
